violations.title: Chemical Sanitizing, Contact Time Met
violations.observation: Chemical sanitizer immersion time was not adequate for quat sanitizing solution. Observed PIC dip dishes then place to air dry
violations.corrective_action: Chemical sanitization (manual or mechanical operations) including the application of sanitizing chemicals by immersion, manual swabbing, brushing, or pressure spraying methods using a solution by providing: 1) an exposure time of at least 10 seconds for a chlorine solution, 2) an exposure time of at least 7 seconds for a chlorine solution of 50mg/L that has a pH of 10 or less and a water temperature of 100F or a pH of 8 or less and a water temperature of 75F, 3) an exposure time of at least 30 seconds for other chemical sanitizing solutions, or 4) an exposure time used in relationship with a combination of temperature, concentration, and pH that when evaluated for efficacy yields sanitization. CDI soaked for 1 minute per chemical directions

violations.title: Food Contact Surfaces Clean to Sight & Touch
violations.observation: The following equipment/utensils were observed soiled to sight and touch: containers holding metal ice cream funnels coated in debris.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment food-contact surfaces and utensils shall be clean to the sight and touch. A surface that is soiled cannot be effectively sanitized. CDI washed rinsed sanitized

out_items.name: Toilet facilities properly constructed, supplied, and cleaned

violations.title: Toilet Rooms Enclosed
violations.observation: Toilet room doors are not provided with a self-closing door.
violations.corrective_action: Provide a self-closing hinge or closing mechanism for the toilet room door.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling is not designed, constructed or installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. Observed duct tape around ceiling tiles by hot water heater and mop sink floor.
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. REPEAT VIOLATION. PLEASE FIX BEFORE NEXT INSPECTION.

out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: OBSERVED CHOCOLATE ICE CREAM IN HANDWASHING SINK AT CASHIER STATION.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. CDI: EMPLOYEE RE-EDUCATED, HANDSINK CLEANED.

violations.title: Hot Holding
violations.observation: The following food item(s) were observed hot holding at improper temperatures using a calibrated food temperature measuring device: OBSERVED IN HOT HOLDING CABINET: BEEF CHILI AT 131F, COOKED BACON AT 94F. PIC STATED SHE PUT THEM IN THE CABINET ON 02/09/26 (MONDAY). ITEMS HAVE BEEN IN THE CABINET TRAYS FOR 4 DAYS.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature conrol for safety food shall be held hot at a temperature of 135F or above unless the permit holder is using 'time as the public health control' as specified under 3-501.19. CDI: BACON AND BEEF CHILI DISPOSED OF. DO NOT USE THIS CABINET UNTIL IT IS WORKING PROPERLY.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored IN WATER WITHOUT SANITIZER.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. CDI: BUCKET DUMPED AND FILLED WITH SANITIZER.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following equipment is not operating properly and/or is in poor repair: HOT CABINET WITH SLIDING TRAYS WAS SET AT 185F AND HOLDING FOOD AT 94-131F.
violations.corrective_action: Equipment shall be maintained in a state of repair and condition that meets the requirements specified under Parts 4-1 and 4-2. CABINET MUST BE REPAIRED OR REPLACED BY 02/23/26. DO NOT USE IT.

out_items.name: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean

violations.title: Floors/Walls/Ceilings, Smooth, Easily Cleanable
violations.observation: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling is not designed, constructed or installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. OBSERVED GAPS IN CEILING AROUND ELECTRIC WIRES/PIPING, SODA PIPING, AND OTHER AREAS OF THE KITCHEN TO BE COVERED IN DUCT TAPE.
violations.corrective_action: Floor, floor covering, walls, wall covering, and ceiling must be designed, constructed and installed to be smooth and easily cleanable. GAPS IN CEILING MUST BE SEALED WITH SOMETHING EASILY CLEANABLE. DUCT TAPE IS NOT EASILY CLEANABLE.
